name: g16_scarf_lock_stays
purpose: The Choice lock stays until the pin ends it. A Choice Scarf Annihilape moves first (Close Combat, which knocks out the Kingambit: the turn stops for the replacement) and then a Rillaboom's Knock Off takes the Scarf: at that stop Annihilape has no item and still has the choicelock volatile (conditions.ts onDisableMove ends it only in endTurn). Next turn it is free.
